record_id.description: Change sys_id (32 hex characters) or number, for example CHG0030002.

task_id.description: Task sys_id to update. Omit to create a new task on the change.

short_description.description: Short summary of the task. Required when creating.

fields.description: Other task fields keyed by column name, for example {"assigned_to": "<user sys_id>", "assignment_group": "<group sys_id>", "state": "3", "close_notes": "..."}.
